jobs.description:

Xenit is a growth company which specializes in Cloud and Modern Work. Our committed employees inspire, challenge and encourage each other, while providing extensive value for our customers. Xenit is Microsoft's Partner of the Year Sweden
for 2024; illustrating our commitment to technical development, being on the cutting edge of tech, and our close partnership with Microsoft.

W H A T W E N E E D 🙏🏻

to join our Information Management
Team

C O U L D Y O U B E A M A T C H ?

We Believe Our Next Colleague Has

5+ years working as a full-stack developer within Microsoft 365, Azure, SharePoint, Azure AD, Cognitive Search and Graph (including specific experience in .NET for web applications and APIs).
Solid experience in developing hybrid solutions based on M365/Azure/SharePoint
Experience with developing solutions based on Microsoft 365 where logic/code runs in Azure, e.g. Webhooks in Azure Functions.
Experience with development of solutions based on SharePoint where logic/code is run locally.
Experience working with DevOps.
Good knowledge of SharePoint Framework (SPFx), CSOM, React, TypeScript and Fluent UI, CSS and SASS.
Documented experience with App Services, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, etc.
Fluent in spoken and written Swedish and English

It is a bonus if you have...

Experience with the development of solutions based on the Microsoft Purview Information Protection and Purview Information Governance concepts.
Experience with the development of Document Management Solutions (ECM) based on Microsoft SharePoint Online and on-prem.
Experience with the development of solutions that include lifecycle management of collaboration surfaces, information, accounts and authorizations.

We Also Believe That You Are a Person Who

Acts on their own initiative, makes things happen and takes responsibility for their work
Has a methodical and structured way of working
Collaborates effectively with others and builds good relationships with both customers and colleagues
Above all else, displays kindness and compassion in everything they do 💕

W H Y C H O O S E X E N I T ?

Benefits 🎁

Xenit boasts a large benefits package, read full list here.

Activities ⛹🏻

Each quarter, we host Xenit Inspire
where employees are able to share specialist knowledge, information about cool projects, and take part in tasks centered around innovation - workshops and hackathons. We also offer annual conferences, team building, after works, and "Bring a Buddy" lunches at the office.

Last year, Xenit was awarded "Career Company of 2024"
. This prestigious recognition underscores our commitment to fostering a workplace culture that values inclusivity, well-being, and growth.

"Xenit is an outstanding employer where corporate culture and well-being are at the center. Here, the employees are part of a warm and inclusive community where their well-being and well-being are prioritized. By offering an environment where collaboration, creativity and innovation are encouraged, employees can thrive and develop while contributing to the company's success."

Read more about Karriar Företagen
here
.

If you have questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact our Head of Talent: Abigail Chapman 💌

Read more here: https://xenit.se/

Xenit's goal is not only to become Sweden's leading cloud partner, but to be Sweden's kindest cloud partner.

Our theory is that satisfied workers produce satisfying work, and so we aim to create a working environment in which our employees can thrive - working independently, flexibly and happily.

We are happy with hybrid remote working, encourage collaboration between offices and freedom in choosing devices/equipment & working hours.

jobs.title: Experienced Software Engineer – Java/.NET Platform
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced software engineer to join the team responsible for developing the software platforms underlying COMSOL Multiphysics®. You will work with the runtimes, libraries, build systems, and platform integrations that form the foundation of a large, cross-platform engineering software product. The majority of the development is done in Java and C#, together with build and automation tooling.About COMSOLCOMSOL develops cutting-edge mathematical modeling software that powers innovations in physics and engineering. Our flagship product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, is widely used across all fields of engineering, manufacturing, and scientific research to model multiphysics systems. Our customers leverage our software to understand, predict, and optimize product designs and processes. Founded in Sweden in 1986, COMSOL has expanded globally with 16 offices employing more than 500 people worldwide.RoleBased in our newly renovated office in central Stockholm, you will join the core group developing the user interface, communication, and data layer functionality of the COMSOL product suite. The group is also responsible for the Application Builder, Model Manager, COMSOL Server, and COMSOL Compiler functionality, which customers use to create, manage, deploy, and run simulation models and apps.In this role, you will work on several of the software platforms on which our products are built. This includes the Java and .NET runtimes and their ecosystems, third-party libraries, database connectivity and persistence technologies, application launchers, build systems, and integration of vendored software. The work spans multiple operating systems and a large codebase with a long development history.You will evaluate and integrate new runtime and library versions, investigate compatibility issues, implement or backport APIs and other changes where needed, and develop automation that makes recurring platform and dependency work more efficient and reliable.The role also provides opportunities to evolve the platforms themselves. Depending on your experience and interests, this can include introducing new platform capabilities and APIs, improving how runtimes and third-party components are integrated, evolving build and development infrastructure, and finding better ways to support development across the product organization. You will have room to identify improvements and contribute to the longer-term technical direction of the areas you work with.Responsibilities include writing and reviewing code, investigating platform and compatibility issues, contributing to technical specifications and design, developing build and platform infrastructure, and testing changes across the supported product platforms.QualificationsFor this position, we are looking for an experienced software engineer with the following qualifications:

M.Sc. or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or physics.
Excellent programming skills with proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language.
Several years of professional software development experience.
An interest in working with complex software systems and improving the technical foundations on which other development depends.

Experience with the following will be highly valued:

Large software projects and mature codebases.
Java and/or .NET runtime environments and their library ecosystems.
Build systems, dependency management, and software packaging.
Cross-platform development on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
Integrating or adapting third-party and open-source software.
Build and development automation.
Designing or evolving software platforms, frameworks, or developer infrastructure.

No background in physics or simulation is required. At COMSOL, you will be part of a company where software developers, mathematicians, physicists, and engineers work together to develop software for science and engineering.Working at COMSOLAt COMSOL, platform engineering is closely connected to product development. You will work on technical foundations used throughout the COMSOL product suite, with opportunities both to ensure that those foundations remain robust and current and to improve how they support future product development. Decisions about runtimes, libraries, build systems, and operating-system support have a direct impact on a complex engineering product with a long lifetime.New team members quickly become essential contributors to ongoing development projects. As the company continues to expand, there are plenty of opportunities for employees to advance in their roles and become leading experts in their areas of focus. This journey will be accompanied by experienced colleagues and a collaborative working environment.We also offer:

A competitive salary
Individual pension plans
Sponsored gym membership
Work-life balance with regular working hours

To ensure a smooth onboarding process, onsite presence is required. Once onboarded, hybrid work options are available.To ApplyDoes this sound interesting? Submit your application in English or Swedish using the form below. Make sure to include:

Cover letter
CV
University diploma with grades

Please include your university diploma with grades, regardless of when the degree was obtained. Kindly note that applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.To recruiters, please note that the target channels for this position have already been selected.For more information, contact Mikael Sterner at tel. 08-412 95 00.We review applications continuously.

jobs.title: Head of Application Development
jobs.description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

Vill du vara med och leda utvecklingen av mjukvara som gör skillnad för cancerpatienter världen över? 

På RaySearch kombinerar vi avancerad teknik med ett tydligt syfte: att förbättra cancervården genom innovativ mjukvara som används på cancerkliniker världen över. Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera ett starkt teknikintresse med ett meningsfullt uppdrag, där ditt ledarskap bidrar till att göra skillnad för människor varje dag.

Nu genomför vi en förändring inom vår utvecklingsorganisation och söker två erfarna ledare till våra nya sektioner Application Development 1 och Application Development 2. Rollerna är centrala i arbetet med att stärka och vidareutveckla vår applikationsutveckling. Tillsammans ansvarar ni för att bygga en stark, skalbar och högpresterande utvecklingsorganisation med fokus på förbättringsarbete, kompetensutveckling, samarbete och leverans. Som en del av vår nya linjeorganisation med fem sektioner inom utvecklingsavdelningen kommer ni att arbeta nära de övriga sektionerna som ansvarar för produktutvecklingens inriktning och genomförande, produkternas säkerhet och validering samt fysik och algoritmutveckling.

Om rollen

Som Head of Application Development ansvarar du för att utveckla organisationen bakom RaySearchs produkter vilka inkluderar RayStation, ett avancerat dosplaneringssystem för strålbehandling, och RayCare, ett innovativt onkologiskt informationssystem som stödjer hela cancerbehandlingsprocessen. Vi arbetar med en modern teknikstack som bland annat omfattar C#, .NET, SQL Server, WPF och React.

Du rapporterar till Director of Development och leder ett antal gruppchefer. Hur ansvar och direktrapporter fördelas mellan de två rollerna avgörs utifrån verksamhetens behov och de personer som tillträder tjänsterna. Ni arbetar nära varandra för att utveckla både era sektioner och avdelningen som helhet.

I rollen som Head of Application Development leder du arbetet med att sätta riktningen för applikationsutvecklingen och ser till att organisationen har förmågan att omsätta den i väl fungerande produkter. Det innebär bland annat att:

•  Utforma och kommunicera strategi för mjukvaruarkitektur, designprinciper och teknisk inriktning.

•  Skapa arbetssätt och styrning som bidrar till hög kvalitet och lösningar som är enkla att vidareutveckla och kan växa med behoven.

•  Driva förbättringsarbete kring utvecklingsprocesser, verktyg, utvecklarnas produktivitet och användningen av AI. 

•  Bygga långsiktig teknisk kompetens utifrån verksamhetens och produkternas behov.

•  Säkerställa rätt bemanning, kompetens och organisatoriska förutsättningar för framgångsrik produktutveckling.

•  Stärka samarbetet mellan team och funktioner så att gemensamma prioriteringar får genomslag.

•  Leda och utveckla chefer och tekniska ledare.

Din profil

Du är en erfaren ledare med bakgrund från avancerad mjukvaruutveckling. Genom din tekniska kompetens och förståelse för mjukvaruarkitektur, utvecklingsprocesser och tekniska vägval kan du bidra till både strategiska beslut och operativ utveckling. Du kan förena långsiktig teknisk strategi med de praktiska förutsättningar som krävs för att team ska kunna leverera med hög kvalitet.

Vi söker dig som har en masterexamen (M.Sc.) eller likvärdig utbildning och som kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Du har gedigen erfarenhet av att driva processförbättringar och öka operativ effektivitet samt ett starkt fokus på resultat, kvalitet och genomförande. Meriterande är om du har erfarenhet av att jobba med medicinskteknisk mjukvara eller inom en annan reglerad verksamhet.

Som ledare har du mycket god kommunikativ förmåga och kan på ett trovärdigt sätt bygga engagemang, skapa samsyn och förmedla både strategiska och tekniska budskap till olika målgrupper. Du driver förändring och får människor med olika kompetenser att lyckas tillsammans. Du trivs i en prestigelös miljö där framgång skapas genom samarbete, kunskapsdelning och gemensamt ansvarstagande.

Ansökan

Du är välkommen att söka tjänsten genom formuläret nedan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail men har du frågor kring tjänsten är du välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterande chef Henrik Friberger, henrik.friberger@raysearchlabs.com

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET/Angular)
jobs.description:
I'm working with an exciting software start-up in Dublin that is continuing to grow its engineering team and is looking to appoint a Senior Software Engineer.

This is a hands on role for someone who enjoys building software, improving existing systems and working closely with other engineers to deliver new product features.

The company is still at a stage where strong engineers can have a real impact, so they are looking for someone experienced who can come in, contribute quickly and help raise the technical standard of the product as it grows.

(Hybrid - Dublin City Centre - 3 days per week on-site)

The role...

You'll work across a modern .NET and Angular environment, building and improving customer facing software within a microservices based architecture.

Responsibilities...

Design, build and maintain software across backend and frontend applications
Develop new features from design through to production
Work hands-on with C#/.NET and Angular
Contribute to architecture and technical design decisions
Build and maintain REST APIs and microservices
Work with relational and NoSQL databases
Improve code quality, testing and release readiness
Use TDD and strong automated testing practices
Troubleshoot production issues and contribute to long-term fixes
Work closely with Product, QA and DevOps
Help improve performance, scalability and reliability
Contribute ideas around modernisation and technical improvement
Take ownership of work rather than simply delivering assigned tickets

Technical environment...

C#
.NET / .NET Core
Angular
REST APIs
Microservices
SQL Server / PostgreSQL
NoSQL
AWS
CI/CD
TDD
Modern automated testing practices

About you...

You'll likely be an experienced Senior Software Engineer with a strong background in .NET development and modern web applications.

You'll ideally have experience with:

C# / .NET
Angular
Microservices
REST API development
SQL databases
TDD
Unit, integration and automated testing
Modern software architecture
Cloud environments
CI/CD
Production troubleshooting
Building and shipping software products

Experience modernising legacy applications or moving monolithic systems towards more modern architectures would be particularly useful.

Why apply?

This is a great opportunity to join a growing software company at a stage where your work will be highly visible.

You'll remain close to the code, have real ownership over what you build and work directly with senior engineering leadership as the product and team continue to develop.

Negotiable salary of €80,000-€90,000 depending on experience.

To speak in absolute confidence about this opportunity, please send an up-to-date CV via the link provided or contact Calum Omand, Specialist Recruitment Consultant at MCS Group, on 015259641.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. Please let us know if you require any adjustments.

Even if this position is not right for you, we may have others that are. Please visit MCS Group to view a wide selection of our current and exclusive roles at www.mcsgroup.jobs

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Barden is delighted to be working with a global tech company as they look to hire an experienced Senior Software Engineer
in Cork.

This is a hands-on engineering role working as part of a team building and evolving a modern data platform. The focus is simple: good engineers, writing good code, solving interesting problems and building software that works well at scale.

You'll be working across backend services, data and platform development, with plenty of scope to contribute to technical decisions and how the platform evolves.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Build and maintain backend services that form part of the company's core data platform.
Write clean, maintainable production code and contribute to technical design decisions.
Work with data, APIs and services that need to be reliable, scalable and easy to evolve.
Contribute to testing, code reviews and engineering standards across the team.
Solve complex technical problems and think carefully about performance, reliability and maintainability.
Work closely with other engineers to build and improve the platform over time.
Make use of modern AI development tools to accelerate development and improve how you work.

ABOUT THE PERSON

7+ years' experience in software engineering
, with strong hands-on experience building production software.
Production experience in Python, C#/.NET, or a similar backend language
.
Strong fundamentals around software design, testing, APIs and databases.
Someone who cares about writing good code and understands what it takes to build and operate software in production.
AI-first. Claude Code and Cursor are part of how the engineering team works, with a strong focus on using these tools effectively while maintaining high standards around code quality and review.

A collaborative engineer who enjoys sharing knowledge through code reviews, pairing and working closely with the wider team.

OTHER DETAILS

Hybrid role - 3 days a week in the office (Cork City)
Permanent position
Competitive base salary + benefits, including family healthcare and pension
